title: pilosella densiflora subsp. acrosciadia
intro: Pilosella densiflora subsp. acrosciadia, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a perennial plant in the Rosaceae family native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella densiflora subsp. acrosciadia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
